title: SEC-002: Consolidate token storage to single key
description: Token is stored in two localStorage keys (arcvault_jwt and arcvault_token) and retrieved from both. This creates inconsistency, potential for stale tokens if one key isn't cleared, and confusion about which key is authoritative. Must consolidate to single key with backwards compatibility migration.

context.current_pattern: Both arcvault_jwt and arcvault_token stored and retrieved
context.issue: Redundant keys, potential stale state, unclear which is authoritative

acceptance_criteria: Create STORAGE_KEYS constant with single TOKEN key
saveToken() saves to arcvault_token only and removes arcvault_jwt
getToken() reads from arcvault_token with fallback to arcvault_jwt for backwards compatibility
All dependent components still authenticate correctly
Existing users with arcvault_jwt token can still log in (migration happens on login)
No duplicate keys in localStorage after fix

implementation_notes.save_token_update:
Save only to STORAGE_KEYS.TOKEN and remove arcvault_jwt
localStorage.removeItem('arcvault_jwt')
implementation_notes.handle_401_update: Clear STORAGE_KEYS.TOKEN instead of both keys
implementation_notes.useAuth_js_update: Import STORAGE_KEYS from api.ts and use it consistently
implementation_notes.backwards_compatibility: First read (getToken) tries new key first, falls back to old key. First write (saveToken) clears old key.

unit_test: Test saveToken('token123') stores to arcvault_token only
Test getToken() returns from arcvault_token if present
Test getToken() falls back to arcvault_jwt if arcvault_token missing
Test after saveToken(), arcvault_jwt is removed
integration_test: Login and verify token is stored in arcvault_token
Manually set arcvault_jwt in localStorage, verify getToken() reads it
Login with arcvault_jwt present, verify it's migrated to arcvault_token
Logout and verify both keys are cleared
manual_test: Check browser DevTools Application tab > localStorage after login
Verify arcvault_token key exists and arcvault_jwt is absent
Test with existing localStorage from old version
Verify all 5 dependent components can authenticate

rollback_plan: git revert <commit-hash> — update both files in same commit for safety
notes: Must update both api.ts and useAuth.js in same commit. Use STORAGE_KEYS constant for consistency. Backwards compatibility is critical for existing users.
